name: Aloo Keema
description: Pakistani aloo keema with beef mince and tender potatoes cooked in a concentrated tomato masala with green chillies and everyday spices.
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into even cubes
Salt to taste and fresh coriander for finishing
method: Heat the oil, add cumin seeds and cook the onion until softened and lightly golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and beef mince. Break the mince apart thoroughly and cook until it changes colour and much of its released moisture evaporates.
Add the tomatoes, green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli, turmeric and salt. Cook until the tomatoes soften and the masala becomes cohesive.
Add the potato cubes with only enough water to help them cook, cover and simmer gently until the potatoes are tender and the beef is fully cooked.
Remove the lid and reduce any excess liquid while stirring gently so the potatoes keep their shape and the keema remains moist rather than dry.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander, taste for salt and serve hot with roti or naan.
image_alt: Pakistani aloo keema with minced meat, potatoes and green chilli in a reduced masala
image_caption: Aloo keema with minced meat and potatoes cooked in a concentrated masala.
technique: Cook the mince and masala first, then add evenly cut potatoes with only enough liquid to soften them. Once the potatoes are nearly tender, uncover and reduce carefully so they stay intact while the keema remains moist.
doneness_cues: Mince should be broken into small even pieces before potatoes are added.
Potato cubes should be fork-tender without collapsing.
Masala should coat both mince and potatoes instead of pooling as thin gravy.
A final stir should not turn the potatoes into mash.
mistakes: Adding potatoes before the mince-tomato base is developed.
Using too much water and then overcooking to remove it.
Stirring vigorously after potatoes become tender.
substitutions: Mutton mince can replace beef with timing adjusted to fat content.
Use waxier potatoes if you want cubes that hold shape especially well.
Green chilli can be reduced without changing the cumin-coriander base.
reheating: Warm gently with a small splash of water, folding rather than stirring hard so potatoes remain intact.
serving: Serve with roti or naan and a simple onion-cucumber salad.
